comparison.objective: Unfold a phone holder and dock a phone upright; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-holder unfolding, alignment, seating, and release versus hex-key use, counterholding, fine adjustment, and physical cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: At least 45° screen angle, phone bottom above 3 cm, alignment, and 10-second released stability versus dynamic stroke/rebound/overload limits and post-lock drift. No separate spec versions were provided.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate passive mechanisms, but the tested abilities and measurable outcomes differ.
